title: Present continuous
goal: Talk about what is happening now and use the -ing form correctly.
goal_it: Parlare di ciò che sta accadendo adesso e usare correttamente la forma -ing.

steps.title: Present continuous: what is happening now
steps.title_it: Present continuous: cosa sta succedendo adesso
en: We use the present continuous for actions happening now, at the moment, and for temporary situations around now.
Form: am / is / are + verb + -ing. Typical time words: now, at the moment, today, this week.
it: Usiamo il present continuous per azioni che avvengono adesso, in questo momento, e per situazioni temporanee.
Forma: am / is / are + verbo + -ing. Parole tipiche: now, at the moment, today, this week.

examples.en: I'm reading a book at the moment.
examples.it: In questo momento sto leggendo un libro.

examples.en: It's raining, so we are staying at home.
examples.it: Sta piovendo, quindi stiamo a casa.

examples.en: My sister is working in Milan this month.
examples.it: Mia sorella lavora a Milano questo mese.

steps.title: The -ing ending: spelling
en: Most verbs just add -ing. Some verbs change a little before -ing.
it: La maggior parte dei verbi prende solo -ing. Alcuni cambiano un po' prima di -ing.

head: Rule
Example
rows: Verb ending in silent -e: drop the -e
One short syllable, vowel + consonant: double the consonant
run → running, swim → swimming, stop → stopping

examples.en: The children are running in the garden.
examples.it: I bambini stanno correndo in giardino.

steps.title: Negatives, questions and stative verbs
steps.title_it: Negative, domande e verbi di stato
en: For the negative we add not after am / is / are. For questions we put am / is / are before the subject.
Some verbs describe states, not actions, and we do not usually use them in the continuous: like, love, want, need, know, understand, believe. We say 'I understand', not 'I am understanding'.
it: Per il negativo si aggiunge not dopo am / is / are. Per le domande si mette am / is / are prima del soggetto.
Alcuni verbi descrivono stati, non azioni, e di solito non si usano al continuous: like, love, want, need, know, understand, believe. Si dice 'I understand', non 'I am understanding'.

steps.q: She ___ a book at the moment.
steps.q_it: In questo momento lei sta leggendo un libro.
steps.why: At the moment shows an action happening now, and she takes is: is reading.
steps.why_it: At the moment indica un'azione in corso e she vuole is: is reading.

steps.q: They ___ football in the park now.
steps.q_it: Adesso stanno giocando a calcio nel parco.

steps.why: With I we use am + -ing: am studying.
steps.why_it: Con I si usa am + -ing: am studying.

steps.q: He ___ (watch) a film at the moment.
steps.q_it: In questo momento sta guardando un film.
steps.why: With he we use is + -ing: is watching.
steps.why_it: Con he si usa is + -ing: is watching.

steps.why: Verbs ending in silent -e lose the -e: writing.
steps.why_it: I verbi che finiscono in -e muta perdono la -e: writing.

steps.hint: run has one short syllable: double the n
steps.why: Run doubles the final consonant: running. With we we use are.
steps.why_it: Run raddoppia la consonante finale: running. Con we si usa are.

steps.q: Look! Anna is ___ (swim) in the sea.
steps.q_it: Guarda! Anna sta nuotando in mare.

steps.why: Subject + aren't + verb with -ing + time word.
steps.why_it: Soggetto + aren't + verbo con -ing + parola di tempo.

steps.why: The negative is am + not + -ing: I'm not listening.
steps.why_it: Il negativo è am + not + -ing: I'm not listening.

steps.why: Is + subject + verb with -ing + the rest.
steps.why_it: Is + soggetto + verbo con -ing + il resto.

steps.why: You takes are in the present continuous: Are you waiting?
steps.why_it: You vuole are al present continuous: Are you waiting?

steps.q: Make a question with a question word.
steps.q_it: Forma una domanda con una parola interrogativa.
steps.why: Question word + are + subject + verb with -ing.
steps.why_it: Parola interrogativa + are + soggetto + verbo con -ing.

steps.why: Understand is a stative verb, so we use the present simple: I understand you.
steps.why_it: Understand è un verbo di stato, quindi si usa il present simple: I understand you.

steps.why: Children = they, so we use are + singing.
steps.why_it: Children = they, quindi si usa are + singing.

steps.q: Where is Marco? He ___ a shower.
steps.q_it: Dov'è Marco? Sta facendo la doccia.
steps.why: Here have is an action (have a shower), so we can use the continuous: is having.
steps.why_it: Qui have è un'azione (fare la doccia), quindi si può usare il continuous: is having.

answers: She is talking on the phone at the moment
She's talking on the phone at the moment
steps.why: Subject + is + verb with -ing + the rest.
steps.why_it: Soggetto + is + verbo con -ing + il resto.

cards.ex: She is working at the moment.
We are staying at home today.
He is learning to drive this week.
They are waiting for the bus.
Look at the sky: it's getting dark.
